description: New engine/catalog versions arrive as PRs; the lab's self-tests (inventory, VERIFIED versions, known gaps) then show what the version changed.
prBodyNotes: 1. `RECORD_INVENTORY=1 pytest tests/selftest/test_engine_inventory.py` - new API names must be tested or classified in `docs/api/engine-classified.toml`.
2. Re-check the "not offered" claims and update `VERIFIED` in `tests/selftest/test_na_claims.py`.

3. Run the engine's tests: `[gap fixed]` and `[claim outdated?]` show what the version changed; move `seen_at` forward with `scripts/gap_register.py confirm`, enter new causes in `docs/gaps.toml`, regenerate `docs/findings.md` (`scripts/gap_register.py findings`), CHANGELOG.md.

packageRules.description: One PR per engine, so a version change is compared on its own.
Iceberg Java runtime of Spark and Flink: one version for both (engines.py and flink/Dockerfile).
pg_lake: the git ref in pg_lake/Dockerfile and the image tag in docker-compose.yml move together.
Images built by the lab itself have no registry; their parts are updated by the custom managers below.
Spark: Iceberg ships Spark runtimes only for some Spark minors (pyproject comment) - majors/minors by hand.
Lab tooling, not under test: monthly, grouped.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: Iceberg Java version of the Spark session (engines.py) and the Flink image (Dockerfile ARG and compose tag).
Flink version in the compose tag of the lab's Flink image (the Dockerfile FROM is found by the dockerfile manager).
pg_lake release built by pg_lake/Dockerfile, and the matching compose tag.
vcpkg used to build pg_lake (date tags).
